- anthropic-skills:skill-creator: Create new skills, modify and improve existing skills, and measure skill performance. Use when users want to create a skill from scratch, edit, or optimize an existing skill, run evals to test a skill, benchmark skill performance with variance analysis, or optimize a skill's description for better triggering accuracy.
- anthropic-skills:xlsx: Use this skill any time a spreadsheet file is the primary input or output. This means any task where the user wants to: open, read, edit, or fix an existing .xlsx, .xlsm, .xltx, .csv, or .tsv file (e.g., adding columns, computing formulas, formatting, charting, cleaning messy data); create a new spreadsheet from scratch or from other data sources; or convert between tabular file formats. Trigger especially when the user references a spreadsheet file by name or path — even casually (like "the xlsx in my downloads") — and wants something done to it or produced from it. Also trigger for cleaning or restructuring messy tabular data files (malformed rows, misplaced headers, junk data) into proper spreadsheets. The deliverable must be a spreadsheet file. Do NOT trigger when the primary deliverable is a Word document, HTML report, standalone Python script, database pipeline, or Google Sheets API integration, even if tabular data is involved.

NEVER call `create_new_file` directly without loading this skill first. Trigger whenever the user wants a new blank Figma file — a new design, FigJam, or Slides file — or when you need a fresh file before calling `use_figma`. Usage — /figma-create-new-file [editorType] [fileName] (e.g. /figma-create-new-file figjam My Whiteboard, /figma-create-new-file slides Q3 Review)

Example prompts (not exhaustive) are 'implement this Figma design', 'build this screen from Figma', 'turn this Figma into code', 'design to code'. Also use when the user asks to create or generate any component in Figma — even a single one — since components require proper variable foundations, variant states, and design token bindings to be production-quality. This skill teaches WHAT to build and in WHAT ORDER — it complements the `figma-use` skill which teaches HOW to call the Plugin API. Both skills should be loaded together.

You DRAFT the design as .dc.html artboards laid out on one pan/zoom canvas; where saving is enabled for the user's account they refine every element visually (click-to-select, a properties panel, inline text editing, undo/redo) and Save publishes a new version for everyone, otherwise they get a view-and-export (PNG/PDF) preview of your draft. content.content: 1 # Nxeon v2 — the "Nexion" design fork 2 3 **This is not the production tree.** It is a full fork of the Nxeon platform with 4 a from-scratch visual language called **Nexion** built over the real backend. The 5 code is real, the database is real, the money paths are real code — but 6 `NXEON_SANDBOX=1`, so no VM is ever provisioned and no card is ever charged. 7 8 Read `docs/NEXION-V2.md` next. This file is the operating manual; that one is the 9 direction and the history of what has been built. 10 11 --- 12 13 ## Where you are, and what that changes 14 15 This tree runs on **node-2** (`nxeon-fsn1`, `178.63.94.114`), and the work is 16 meant to happen there. Check which box you are on before anything else: 17 18 ```bash 19 hostname # nxeon-fsn1 = node-2. Anything else = the primary node. 20 ``` 21 22 **On node-2 (`nxeon-fsn1`) — the normal case.** Edit here and build here: 23 24 ```bash 25 npx tsc --noEmit # always, before a build 26 ./rebuild.sh # stop, build, restart. ~125s. 27 ``` 28 29 **On the PRIMARY node.** Do not build. The primary is an 8-core box that also 30 runs the customer game-server VMs (darkeden-guard-sg, projectzomboid, dst, 31 terraria, valheim…) and sits at load ~11 before anyone types anything. A 32 `next build` there competes with paying customers for CPU. Edit if you must, 33 then: 34 35 ```bash 36 scripts/deploy-node2.sh # ships the commit, typechecks + builds ON node-2 37 ``` 38 39 It refuses to run on a dirty tree (it ships commits, not a working directory) 40 and refuses to reset over commits node-2 has and the primary doesn't. 41 42 **One source of truth at a time.** The deploy script does `git reset --hard` on 43 node-2. Once you are working on node-2, the primary's copy is stale — do not 44 deploy from it again without reconciling, or you will silently discard node-2's 45 commits. The script checks for this and stops; take the stop seriously. 46 47 ## The tree 48 49 | | | 50 |---|---| 51 | Path | `/opt/nxeon-v2` | 52 | Branch | `design/v2` | 53 | Service | `nxeon-v2-web` on port **3021** | 54 | Public URL | https://v2.q4w8zt3ky6vn2sm.nxeon.cloud | 55 | Database | `nxeon_v2` on localhost — **separate** from prod and from the primary's own copy | 56 | Logins | `/root/nxeon-v2-credentials.txt` (admin + a design customer account) | 57 | Build log | `/tmp/nxeon-v2-build.log` | 58 59 `rebuild.sh` skips the marketing site by default (~137 of ~195 route files, and 60 it dominates a build we run by hand after every change). `NX_FULL=1 ./rebuild.sh` 61 builds everything — do that before any staging or prod pass. 62 63 Schema changes: `npm run db:push`. There are no migration files. The primary node 64 and node-2 have **separate** `nxeon_v2` databases, so a push on one does nothing 65 to the other. 66 67 ## Reaching node-1 (live production) from here 68 69 node-2 has **root SSH to node-1**, granted by the owner on 2026-09-11, because 70 three things a Nexion session needs live only there: the board concept 71 attachments (~500 MB across ~99 cards — the design source of truth), the 72 production database (for checking a claim against real data instead of sandbox 73 seed data), and the real production tree to compare the fork against. 74 75 Use `scripts/node1.sh` rather than raw ssh — quoting a psql call through two 76 levels of ssh is where this reliably goes wrong: 77 78 ```bash 79 scripts/node1.sh cards "dashboard" # find concept cards by title 80 scripts/node1.sh board # list that card's attachments 81 scripts/node1.sh pull # copy them to /tmp/board/ 82 scripts/node1.sh db "select …" # read-only query against PROD 83 scripts/node1.sh sh '' # anything else 84 ``` 85 86 **That grant is wide, and node-1 runs every customer VM, the production 87 database and the mail server. Treat it as read-only.** Never write to the prod 88 DB (the `db` subcommand refuses obvious writes, which is a guard against a slip, 89 not a security boundary), never edit `/opt/nxeon`, never build there, never 90 restart a prod service. If you genuinely need to change something on node-1, 91 **stop and ask the owner first.** 92 93 ## Rules that are not negotiable 94 95 1. **Never fabricate.** No invented stats, ratings, reviews, player counts, ETAs 96 or capabilities. If a number cannot be read from the database or from a real 97 upstream, the field stays empty and the UI says why. This tree has already had 98 hash-derived star ratings and fake customer reviews removed once — do not 99 reintroduce that shape. When a source cannot answer, say so; never render a 100 `0` that reads as a real measurement. 101 2. **Never run builds in `/opt/nxeon`.** That is live production; clobbering its 102 `.next` has taken the admin panel down before. 103 3. **Never `pkill -f` by pattern on either box.** `pkill -f "next start"` 104 restarted live production once. Kill by port PID or systemd unit. 105 4. **Never `git add -A` in a symlinked worktree** — it can replace prod's real 106 `node_modules` with a self-referential symlink. 107 5. **Ask before touching credentials** on live customer infrastructure, and 108 before spending on any paid third-party tool. 109 6. **Never send a support-ticket reply** without explicit sign-off. 110 7. **`/opt/nxeon-sandbox` belongs to a different session.** Leave it alone. 111 8. Secrets are gitignored. Never commit `.env` or a credentials file. 112 113 ## Verification discipline 114 115 A change is not done until it is **deployed and screenshotted**. There is a 116 login-and-capture script: 117 118 ```bash 119 node scripts/shot.mjs /tmp/out /dashboard/directory /dashboard/settings 120 # defaults to the design customer account; override with NX_EMAIL / NX_PASS 121 ``` 122 123 Playwright scripts must live inside `/opt/nxeon-v2` so the module resolves. Read 124 the PNG back and actually look at it — a sliced game wordmark, a clipped top bar 125 and an empty Mods tab were all invisible in the code and obvious in a screenshot. 126 127 ## Things that have already cost hours here 128 129 - **Bash `cwd` does not persist between tool calls.** Always `cd /opt/nxeon-v2 && …`. 130 - **`git commit -m` with backticks in the message breaks.** Write the message to 131 a file and use `git commit -F`. 132 - **`git bundle create f A..B` with two raw SHAs** makes a bundle with no refs, 133 which git refuses as empty. The tip must be a named ref: `A..design/v2`. 134 - **A positioned `fixed; z-0` aurora layer paints above static content.** Page 135 content needs `relative z-[1]`. 136 - **A `backdrop-filter` ancestor becomes the containing block for `fixed` 137 children** — `createPortal` to `document.body` instead. 138 - **Never size a fixed overlay from a header's height.** That is the header's 139 bottom edge only when nothing sits above it, and the sandbox banner does. Let 140 the layout place things. 141 - **`mask-composite` is unevenly supported** — nest two single-axis masks. 142 - **An `` that fails before hydration never fires `onError`.** Check 143 `el.complete && el.naturalWidth === 0` on mount. 144 - **`fetch` cannot report request-body progress in any browser.** Upload progress 145 needs `XMLHttpRequest.upload.onprogress`. 146 - **Shell-level React providers are easy to drop.** The Nexion shell omitted 147 `ComposeProvider`, then `TerminalDockProvider`, then `MatrixProvider` — each 148 took a whole feature down invisibly, because the crash only appears on a route 149 a smoke test does not walk. Anything added to `components/portal/Shell.tsx` 150 must be added to `components/nx/Shell.tsx` too. 151 152 ## Conventions inherited from the platform (still true here) 153 154 - Every VM state change goes through a `Job` row. The web app never calls Proxmox 155 mutation endpoints directly. 156 - One in-flight job per server. 157 - Wallet amounts are integer cents. 158 - Admin-only actions call `requireAdmin()` and refuse to render while impersonating. 159 - Charts are dependency-free SVG in `components/ui/charts.tsx`. Do not add a 160 charting library. 161 162 ## Inherited instructions that do NOT apply here 163 164 The production `CLAUDE.md` this replaced is kept at 165 `docs/CLAUDE-production-inherited.md` for reference. It describes the PRIMARY 166 node. To avoid a very expensive mistake: 167 168 - **Do not** run `systemctl restart nxeon-web nxeon-worker` — that is production. 169 This tree's unit is `nxeon-v2-web`. 170 - **Do not** publish docs to `revsports.ca/docs` from here. 171 - **Do not** run `scripts/promote-production.sh` or `scripts/deploy-staging.sh`. 172 - There is no post-commit auto-push hook on node-2, and there should not be: 173 `design/v2` is a design fork, not something to push to `origin` casually. 174
